authority: Independent challenge for main review, not a replacement execution manifest. Existing disabled operations remain unchanged.
criteria: Substantive continuing development of own or jointly developed relevant technology qualifies, including OSS-based software or original maintained technical processes. Generic consulting/support/resale and client-only custom implementation do not. No patent, exclusivity, internal-only engineering, multi-customer or standalone-product requirement.
method: Re-read current first-party catalogues and named product/project branches, supplementing prior durable evidence. Public direct HTML retrieval used where web reader failed. Recommendations are bounded evidence assessments, not proof that undisclosed technology cannot exist.
reconciliation: Authoritative counts remain 893 keep, 22 exclude including already-unmapped Wittwer, 10 uncertain pending main acceptance. If walkingtoweb withdrawal is accepted: 893 keep, 21 exclude including Wittwer, 11 uncertain, 20 pending removals. No newer production read or independent review of subsequent imports is claimed.

results.name: webunique

results.name: walkingtoweb GmbH
results.finding: The blue.project page says in first person that blue has been developed continuously for over 25 years, while assigning licensing/support and detailed functions to partner walkingtoyou. Company history identifies walkingtoyou as the FileMaker developer. These statements do not settle walkingtoweb's own or joint development responsibility; a categorical reseller-only conclusion is unsafe.

limits: No automatic exclusions from missing evidence, access failures or quiet social accounts. No production mutation, action-time approval or removal execution. Incendia and WOn-Data require main's explicit scope review.
